title: 第266章 当别杨知绿杨起家遇到了真蜂医
slug: 三角洲招募威龙创电竞gti
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“怎么回事，发生什么了杨哥。”

“怎么声音听起来这么绝望呢？”

接通电话，那熟悉的声线自是让林修一下子就认出了对方的身份，正是杨起家。

而从他这满是崩溃的声音就可以听出，在过去的好几个小时里，他可谓是饱受手里这个大黑号的折磨。

最后实在不行了，才想着来找林修求救的。

“打不过，根本打不过啊林哥！”

“我本来以为这就是一个普普通通的大兵号，就打算用老办法，老流程去给他拯救成功。”

“比如说从普坝开始，再到机密大坝，到绝密巴克什，再去航天修两把脚，这就拯救成功了！”

“但你猜怎么着？”

“普坝遇到他妈蹲大保险丢C4的，机密大坝遇到堵撤离点的。”

“打个巴克什对面一连三个小麦，六个闪光无人机给我闪的根本不敢看前面，但身边又没有掩体。”

“你知道当时的我有多绝望吗？我要是不背闪，就得连吃六个闪光，根本看不到人被打死。”

“我背闪了，因为附近又没有掩体，只能把自己的后背露出来给他们让他们突突。”

“这我怎么玩呀？”

“然后就是没钱了之后去航天跑刀，想着卡个战备去吃点，吃完不管是杨清还是丢包，这都多少能挣点。”

“哪怕是被串子串我也认了，反正就是尽快早点结束这个号我就解脱了。”

“可是这号黑就黑在对局强度高，对局质量神，爆率也是一点没有。”

“我在没被人抓到之前可是足足吃了三个核心区，当时他们还在外面打，我还以为能爽吃呢。”

“结果三个核心区一共才给我出了三个小金，剩下的全是小紫，不是耳环就是箭矢，这我玩什么啊？”

“这我玩他个母牛！艹！”

越说越气，越说越气。

一边在跟自己好哥们哭诉着，杨起家一边因为一口气说了这么多话没换气搞得自己差点被憋死，

在原地咳嗽，大口呼吸了好一阵子后。

他这才终于舒缓了一些情绪，但也依旧能透过屏幕的感受到他满心的委屈。

和他比起来，自己刚才这几把在绝密航天打的超级唐王局，那是真的很爽了吧？

不对，就自己那几波的体验，换做谁来谁不感觉爽啊，就算是专业猛攻哥来了，

偶尔打那么两把轻松惬意高爆局他也一样很享受的！

“那你现在打电话给我是怎么说，有什么想法吗？”

“我这边再找两个猛的陪你踢回去？”

“你说你在巴克什被猛踢，那我直接给你安排个无名，让他给你清塔爽吃怎么说？”

当林修的这番话被电话传导过去杨起家的直播间。

他本人都还没有反应呢，直播间的观众就先爆了。

【卧槽！无敌的名！终于又要返厂了吗？】

【我说白了，GTI的无名是真无名，真牛逼吧，如果不是现在还没那技术，我都真觉得他是不是有脑机了！】

【无名好啊，巴别塔清塔，COS新的地图BOSS，感觉很有节目啊！】

【是的是的，以往杨哥找的二顶懂都是去打航天清图一把吃一千万，虽然吃得多，但也确实看腻了。】

【确实是真想看杨哥在巴克什爽吃的表现了，说不定就出三幻神了呢？】

听着林修口中所说，看着弹幕这般画饼。

不得不说，你杨哥在成功于脑中模拟出现场画面，并正式开始yy了之后现实里确实是有点心动的。

毕竟巴克什的资源集中是众所周知的，如果不需要考虑被人打死这个因素，

有无名这么一个魔王护全程跟着的话，就算爆率再低、那也是能爽吃的吧！

杨起家很心动，但他的理智最终还是成功战胜了欲望，阻止了他的答应！

没错，虽然按照上面说的，如果能爽吃整个巴别塔的话，就算爆率再差也确实能吃到东西。

但要是真爆率差到一定地步了，他肯定就不乐意，就不想去摸了！

比如现在！

比如刚才那把航天！

你说航天资源不如巴别塔集中这是事实，但他一连吃了三个核心区，最后却只出了三个小金这也是事实啊！

他现在真的好想好想，好想玩个高爆率的号，好想体验一下摸金的快乐啊！

“那什么，林哥，找无名来护航什么的就不必了吧？”

“我的意思是什么呢？因为我之前和你家主播打这么多把，好像都用的是不同的号。”

“包括我也有注意到，你们平日里直播的号也是那个、就怎么说呢....不像是租的，像是自己养起来的。”

“所以我就想问问，你们俱乐部是不是有专门的养号部门，有没有什么高爆率的号给我玩一玩啊？”

“我真的好想爽摸一把金啊！”

"What's going on, what happened, Brother Yang."

"Why does your voice sound so desperate?"

When the call was answered, Lin Xiu immediately recognized the identity of the other party from the familiar voice. It was Yang Qijia.

And from his broken voice, you could tell that he had been tortured by this big black trumpet in his hand for several hours.

Finally, he couldn't help it anymore, so he decided to come to Lin Xiu for help.

"I can't beat him, I can't beat him at all, Brother Lin!"

"I originally thought this was an ordinary soldier, so I planned to use the old methods and procedures to successfully rescue him."

"For example, start from the common dam, then go to the secret dam, then go to the top secret Baksh, and then go to the aerospace industry to build up two feet. This is a successful rescue!"

"But guess what?"

"In general dams, there are people who squatted down and lost C4, and in confidential dams, there are people who blocked the evacuation point."

"Hit three wheats in a row across from Baksh, and six flash drones flashed at me so hard that I didn't even dare to look ahead, but there was no cover around me."

"Do you know how desperate I was at that time? If I didn't backdash, I would have had to take six flashes in a row, and I wouldn't be able to see anyone being killed."

"I ducked with my back, because there was no cover nearby, so I had to expose my back to them and let them jump."

"How can I play with this?"

"Then after I ran out of money, I went to the aerospace industry to do some hunting. I thought I would get ready to eat some. After eating, whether it was Yang Qing or throwing bags, I could earn some money."

"Even if I am being skewered, I will accept it. Anyway, if I end this account as soon as possible, I will be free."

"But what's so bad about this number is that the intensity of the game is high, the quality of the game is amazing, and the explosion rate is not at all."

"I ate three core areas before I was caught. They were still fighting outside at that time. I thought it would be a good meal."

"In the end, the three core areas only gave me three little golds in total, and the rest were all little purples, either earrings or arrows. What am I playing with?"

"I'm playing like a cow! Fuck you!"

The more he talks, the angrier he gets, the more he talks, the angrier he gets.

While crying to his best friend, Yang Qijia almost suffocated to death because he couldn't breathe after saying so many words at once.

After coughing in place and breathing heavily for a long time.

He finally felt relieved, but he could still feel his grievance through the screen.

Compared with him, the Super Tang King games he just played in the top-secret aerospace were really exciting, right?

No, based on my experience in those few waves, no one else would feel comfortable coming here, even if the professional onslaught guy comes,

He also enjoys playing two relaxing and high-explosive rounds occasionally!

"Then what did you say when you called me now? Do you have any ideas?"

"Shall I find two more fierce ones here to accompany you and kick you back?"

"You said you were kicked hard in Bakshi, so what do you think I'll arrange for you to be named Wu Ming and let him give you a refreshing meal?"

When Lin Xiu's words were transmitted over the phone to Yang Qijia's live broadcast room.

Even before he could react, the audience in the live broadcast room exploded.

【Fuck!Invincible name!Is it finally time to return to the factory again?】

[Let me put it bluntly, GTI's Wuming is really Wuming, he is really awesome. If he didn't have that technology yet, I really think he has a brain machine!】

[Unnamed is good, the Tower of Babel is clear, the new COS map BOSS, it feels like a great show!】

[Yes, yes, in the past, the top two people Brother Yang found were to play space clearing pictures and earn 10 million in one go. Although he ate a lot, he was really tired of watching it.】

[I really want to see Brother Yang’s performance in Bakshi Shuangchi, maybe there will be three phantom gods?】

Listening to what Lin Xiu said, watching the barrage was so confusing.

I have to say that after you, Brother Yang, successfully simulated the scene in your mind and officially started sexual intercourse, you were actually a little excited in reality.

After all, Bakshi's concentration of resources is well known. If there is no need to consider the factor of being beaten to death,

If there is a demon king guard like Wu Ming following him throughout the whole process, even if the explosion rate is low, it will still be fun!

Yang Qijia was very moved, but his reason finally succeeded in defeating his desire and prevented him from agreeing!

Yes, although according to what was said above, if you can eat the entire Tower of Babel, you can still eat something even if the explosion rate is poor.

But if the true explosion rate drops to a certain level, he will definitely be unhappy and not want to touch it!

Like now!

For example, that aerospace thing just now!

You said that it is true that aerospace resources are not as concentrated as the Tower of Babel, but it is also true that he occupied three core areas in a row and only produced three small golds in the end!

He really wants to think about it now, he really wants to play an account with a high explosion rate, and he really wants to experience the joy of touching gold!

"Then, Brother Lin, there's no need to ask Wuming to escort us or something, right?"

"What do I mean? Because I have played so many games with your anchor before, and they all seemed to use different accounts."

"Including me, I also noticed that the account you use for live broadcasts on weekdays is also the same. How can I put it... It doesn't look like it was rented, it looks like it was raised by yourself."

"So I just want to ask, does your club have a special account maintenance department? Do you have any high-explosion accounts for me to play with?"

"I really want to touch a fortune!"
